related_issues.reason: Also concerns exclude-newer-package entries and lock behaviour, but asks to prune stale entries, not to report all changed packages in the re-resolve message.
Also about exclude-newer-package interacting with lock updates, but the symptom is config being undone by other dependency actions, not the invalidation log message.

rationale: The reporter's template label is bug and the repro is complete: command, exact output, uv version and platform. The lockfile is correctly persisted with both exclude-newer entries, but the 'Resolving despite existing lockfile due to ...' message names only the first changed package (urllib3) and drops requests. That is an incomplete diagnostic in uv itself, so bug is the right type and no external cause is involved. Searches for the message text and for exclude-newer-package found no existing issue with the same root cause and outcome, so no duplicates are listed. Related issues 18792 and 17999 touch exclude-newer-package but describe different problems. The docs search (resolution.md, indexes.md) confirmed exclude-newer-package semantics but did not contradict the expected behaviour. A maintainer can act on this without asking the reporter.
